name: Deploy to Azure Container App (STAGE)

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - stage
  workflow_dispatch:

env:
  AZURE_CONTAINER_REGISTRY: animorhpayrolldev.azurecr.io
  CONTAINER_APP_NAME: ca-stage-payrollv2
  RESOURCE_GROUP: rg-payroll-dev
  IMAGE_NAME: payroll-api-stage
  NODE_ENV: staging

jobs:
  build-test-deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: 'yarn'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install

      - name: Run tests
        run: yarn test

      - name: Azure Login
        uses: azure/login@v2
        with:
          creds: ${{ secrets.AZURE_CREDENTIALS }}

      - name: Login to Azure Container Registry
        run: az acr login --name animorhpayrolldev

      - name: Build and Push Docker image
        run: |
          IMAGE_TAG=${{ github.run_number }}
          echo "IMAGE_TAG=$IMAGE_TAG" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          docker build \
            --build-arg NODE_ENV=$NODE_ENV \
            -t $AZURE_CONTAINER_REGISTRY/$IMAGE_NAME:$IMAGE_TAG \
            -f Dockerfile .
          docker push $AZURE_CONTAINER_REGISTRY/$IMAGE_NAME:$IMAGE_TAG
          echo "$IMAGE_TAG" > image_tag.txt

      - name: Upload image tag artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: image-tag
          path: image_tag.txt

      - name: Deploy to Azure Container App (STAGE)
        run: |
          az containerapp update \
            --name $CONTAINER_APP_NAME \
            --resource-group $RESOURCE_GROUP \
            --image $AZURE_CONTAINER_REGISTRY/$IMAGE_NAME:${{ env.IMAGE_TAG }}

      - name: Output deployed version
        run: echo "✅ Staging deployed $AZURE_CONTAINER_REGISTRY/$IMAGE_NAME:${{ env.IMAGE_TAG }}"
